The client is committed to shaping resilient, secure, and scalable technology solutions that protect operational technology (OT) environments while advancing data-led transformation across substations and enterprise data platforms. It offers the opportunity to shape resilient, secure, and scalable technology solutions that protect critical national infrastructure while advancing data-led transformation. This will form a significant part of the day-to-day focus, ensuring that all technical delivery activities uphold the highest standards of security, resilience, and operational continuity. Alongside cybersecurity delivery, the role will drive the data architecture and migration agenda by defining and delivering cloud-native data platforms, migration solutions, and enterprise architecture roadmaps using Azure and related technologies. The candidate will shape scalable and future-ready data architectures that support the client's broader data-led transformation objectives. The role also involves end-to-end vendor and procurement management, including engaging solution, hardware, and networking vendors across the delivery lifecycle. This covers product assessment, procurement activities, review of technical artefacts, and oversight of quality, deliverables, and delivery timelines, ensuring that vendor engagements consistently align with programme outcomes. Programme governance is a further core area of responsibility. The candidate will maintain delivery plans, architecture controls, and formal governance mechanisms across risk, issue, and change management. This includes ensuring compliance evidence, governance reviews, and architectural controls are effectively established and consistently applied throughout the programme lifecycle. Finally, the role requires strong stakeholder and team leadership. The candidate will coordinate cross-functional teams and act as the primary technical liaison for the client's senior business, OT engineering, and technology stakeholders — providing clear technical leadership, facilitating alignment across teams, and ensuring stakeholder confidence in delivery outcomes. Job Requirements Essential Skills Extensive experience delivering technical, data or cybersecurity programmes within energy, utilities or another critical-infrastructure environment. Strong knowledge of OT cybersecurity, network resilience, substation technology or closely related operational environments. Strong data architecture and engineering capability across Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks, SAP HANA or comparable cloud platforms. Proven vendor, procurement and technical delivery management skills. Strong architecture governance, risk management and senior stakeholder engagement capability. Good working knowledge of Agile SCRUM, PRINCE2 and Waterfall delivery frameworks. Hands-on understanding of SQL, Oracle, .NET, Python, scripting, APIs and test automation. Nice To Have Skills Experience of a regulated UK utility (such as electricity transmission) or comparable critical national infrastructure environment. Knowledge of SAP ISU, Oracle SOA and enterprise integration environments. Experience producing Business Process Design Documents and standardised reference architecture patterns. Exposure to vulnerability assessment, UI and API testing, Jenkins, Postman or JMeter. Experience leading 24/7 platform support or service operations. Understanding of data migration, technical debt reduction and design authority processes. Qualifications Master's degree in Software Engineering or a closely related discipline. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related subject. Microsoft Azure Fundamentals and Azure Data Fundamentals certifications are desirable. Travel Requirements Yes – Travel to the client's substations, laboratories, offices, and vendor locations may be required. The role should support hybrid and on-site working as delivery needs dictate. Why This Role Is Exciting This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of secure and resilient operational technology in one of the UK's most critical sectors. You will work at the intersection of OT cybersecurity, cloud data architecture, and enterprise programme delivery — directly protecting critical national infrastructure while advancing large-scale, data-led transformation. The role provides exposure to substation environments, senior business and engineering stakeholders, and cutting-edge Azure-based data platforms. CogWW901

Join us to help scale innovation globally and shape what’s next in crop science. The Engineering Lead – Regional Operations is responsible for setting and realizing the vision for IT solutions within their portfolio of products, platforms, and services. Specific to this role, this includes managing and optimizing IT operations across a defined geographic region. overseeing field services, ensuring effective site management, and leading local IT teams to deliver high-quality IT support and services. This role reports to the Enterprise IT Operations Leader. The ideal candidate for this position has a proven record of accomplishment of blending strategic planning, operational management, and leadership skills that ensure the efficient functioning of IT systems and services at regional sites. The candidate needs to be comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative, and highly matrixed environment. This includes working with ambiguity, creating operational maturity vs. having it already in place, and having successful experience managing operations and hiring and developing talent. How does an Engineering Lead work? Through Strategic Partnerships: Build and maintain strong and credible relationships across Corteva IT and our strategic partners and vendors Harmonizes Business Needs and IT Strategies: Keeps a secure and differentiating employee or customer experience at the forefront of all they do. Oversees clear business capability definition and ensures alignment to technology products and services are in place to support. Enables a High-Quality IT Product Portfolio: Drives value realization from products, services, interactions, assets, and capabilities as defined by business cases or similar tools Monitors IT Products, Platforms, and Services: Regularly review metrics and health dashboards to assess availability and productivity of the products in their portfolio; proactively identifies services and service levels to manage business-partner expectations What are the Engineering Lead’s Skills and Behaviors? Technology IQ: Grow in knowledge and understanding of leading and emerging technologies related to their associated technology product families. Participate in industry peer groups to understand industry trends. Business IQ: Build an understanding of their business partners and how they fit within Corteva overall; participate in industry peer groups to understand industry trends. Accountable to share insights through metrics, charts, status reports, to bring visibility into work being done. Communicates regularly, how their actions contribute to the success of the organization. Being accountable to share insights through metrics, charts, status reports, bring visibility into work being done, communicate regularly, share how the work contributes to the success of the organization Stays Curious: Deep understanding of Corteva strategic/operational challenges and determines how to meet current and emerging business needs. Stay aware of new and emerging technologies, and their potential value to Corteva. Supports Common Ways of Working: Creates a culture that embraces industry best practices and innovation through collaboration with all internal and external stakeholders. Customer Focused: Strong commitment to delivering high-quality IT services and maintaining customer satisfaction What are the Engineering Lead’s Primary Responsibilities? Operational Management: Oversee IT operations and field services for multiple sites within the region, ensuring consistent delivery of IT services and support. Manage IT infrastructure, including hardware, software, and network systems, to ensure they meet operational requirements and performance standards. Team Leadership and Development: Lead and manage regional IT teams, including field service technicians, site IT support staff, and other regional IT personnel. Provide coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities to team members. Ensure adequate staffing levels and manage scheduling to meet service demands. Service Delivery and Quality Assurance: Develop and implement service level agreements (SLAs) and operational procedures to ensure high-quality IT service delivery. Monitor performance metrics, track service quality, and address any issues or areas for improvement. Ensure timely resolution of IT incidents and service requests, maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction. Site Management: Oversee IT operations at regional sites, including hardware and software installations, maintenance, and upgrades. Coordinate with site managers and other stakeholders to ensure IT systems support local business operations effectively. Ensure compliance with organizational policies, standards, and regulatory requirements at each site. Strategic Planning and Optimization: Develop and execute regional IT strategies aligned with organizational goals and objectives. Identify opportunities for process improvements, cost savings, and increased efficiency in regional IT operations. Manage budgets and resources for IT operations within the region, ensuring optimal use of financial and technical resources. Project Management: Lead and manage regional IT projects, including system upgrades, deployments, and new technology implementations. Coordinate with project teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure project goals are met within scope, time, and budget constraints. Vendor and Contract Management: Manage relationships with external vendors and service providers, including negotiating contracts and ensuring compliance with service agreements. Evaluate vendor performance and make recommendations for improvements or changes as needed. Incident and Problem Management: Oversee the management of IT incidents and problems, ensuring effective root cause analysis and resolution. Implement and maintain incident response and escalation procedures to handle critical issues promptly. Communication and Reporting: Maintain effective communication with regional and corporate leadership, providing regular updates on IT operations, service performance, and project status. Prepare and present reports on regional IT performance, service levels, and operational metrics. Site Assessments: Understand on an ongoing basis the changing needs and state of equipment in sites as it relates to infrastructure, end points, video collaboration, and print. Proactively stay ahead of devices approaching obsolescence. Demand Management: Ensure all incoming work from all sources, which include Server, Network, Application, Security and Business requests are fulfilled in alignment with SLA and business expectations with appropriate urgency. Risk Management and Compliance: Identify and manage risks associated with IT operations, including cybersecurity threats and operational disruptions. Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, industry standards, and organizational policies. Security and Compliance: Implement and enforce security policies and procedures to safeguard data and systems. Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations. Seek, embrace, and maintain strategic partnerships with product vendors and suppliers Establish strong connections between the respective teams within IT. They should have a deep understanding of the interdependent relationship between all parts of the EIT organization. Ensure personnel and infrastructure are in compliance with external FDA & SOX regulations and any other relevant regional or local regulations (e.g., GDPR). Participate in audits as required Provides leadership, coaching and direction to a team of highly skilled global workforce of employee and contingent workers Incorporate operational excellence standards into daily operations to continually improve performance Other duties, as assigned Position Requirements & Critical Experience – What You Will Bring Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience). 3-5 years proven experience IT operations management, including field services and site-based IT support. Experience in leading IT teams and managing multiple locations is essential. Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, and hardware. Familiarity with IT service management frameworks and methodologies. Leadership Skills: Demonstrated leadership ability with experience in team management, coaching, and performance management. Project Management: Experience in managing IT projects, with strong organizational and problem-solving skills. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with various stakeholders. Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Ability to communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent product management skills Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills Strong ability to engage with a global team and provide coaching and oversight Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks within the constraints of timeline and budget Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn rapidly and master diverse technologies and techniques Other Preferred Qualifications Certifications in project management (e.g., PMP) or IT service management (e.g., ITIL) can be beneficial. ITIL, Agile, PMP certification(s) Operating in an Infrastructure as Product (IaP) environment Experience in strategy, customer service, and internal consulting Proven success in contributing to a collaborative environment Proven ability to work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment Adaptable: Ability to adapt to changing circumstances and manage multiple priorities effectively. Detail-Oriented: Strong attention to detail in managing IT operations and ensuring service quality. Corteva announced to separate our current advanced seed and genetics business to establish a standalone company, operating as Vylor, Inc. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to legal requirements and board approval. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the separation, you would be an employee of Vylor, Inc. and your employment would be governed by Vylor, Inc. employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by Vylor, Inc. at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

review_candidates.title: Systems and Infrastructure (Intelligent Infrastructure) Speculative Opportunities
review_candidates.description: Job Description What if you could do the kind of work the world needs? At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. To find out more about our Intelligent Infrastructure (II) business click on the following link and discover what awaits you at WSP: Intelligent Infrastructure services (I&I) | WSP The Systems & Infrastructure group of II provides high value advisory and design services which strive to make everyday transportation and infrastructure cleaner, safer and more enjoyable through the use of technology. The Systems & Infrastructure group specialises in five technical areas: Connectivity – Offering Business and Technical advice on a wide range of solutions that interconnect applications and devices to support clients’ diverse needs. Providing Standards Advisory, Technical Assurance and Design services in the 4G/5G, LPWAN, Unified Communications, WAN and Fibre technology areas. Cyber security –Our Cyber Security services support clients operating Critical National Infrastructure, with specialists across the cyber security lifecycle for all non-classical-IT, IoT and mixed environments. Data and architecture - We advise clients on what is possible and use data to deliver their objectives. We use analytics and data science techniques to put the right information in the hands of decision makers. Our architects leverage transport domain expertise to work across business, application, and technology layers to enable client solutions. Digital infrastructure design – Using data in digital models so that geographic and technical constraints affecting a new roadside technology design works first time when implemented in the real-world environment. Systems - We apply systems engineering and systems thinking to delivery of complex solutions. The focus of our capability is on the specification, procurement, verification and validation of primarily operational technology systems. We are seeking enthusiastic consultants, engineers and project managers of all levels to provide support to our capabilities above. We also have specific current vacancies open – search for ‘Intelligent Infrastructure’. What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate… A technical background with relevant qualifications (degree, or similar higher education qualification) in any of the technical areas listed above, including: Experience in working on high-quality consultancy-style projects aligned with one or more of the technical areas described above Experience working either as a client, consultant or contractor, ideally within a transport, public sector, or high-risk environment. A degree in a relevant engineering discipline and the added recognition of a professional registration with an accredited institute, or equivalent industry experience. Please submit your CV for this position, and it will be reviewed against all current and anticipated vacancies. Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world. With us, you can. Apply today. About Us We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? Work-life balance At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community. Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK. Inclusivity & Belonging We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity. Health & Wellbeing We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme. Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package. Flex your time To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day. We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you. Your development We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership. #WeAreWSP Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.

review_candidates.description: Location: Flexible across Scotland (Hybrid) Employment type: One-Year Fixed Term An exciting opportunity has arisen for a professional and experienced administrator to join the Scottish Ambulance Service on a fixed term basis within the Clinical Directorate. The post holder will provide a confidential, efficient, effective and high-quality administrative support service, with a particular focus on supporting the delivery of key activities associated with the Pathway Navigation Hub. The Pathway Navigation Hub provides clinicians with a single point of contact within SAS, supporting them to identify, access and navigate the range of alternative pathways available to connect patients with the most appropriate services. We are looking for a motivated, organised and adaptable individual with excellent communication and interpersonal skills. The successful candidate will be able to work effectively under pressure, manage competing priorities and contribute positively as part of a wider team. Previous administrative experience within the NHS or a similar healthcare environment would be advantageous. Applicants Should Be Able To Demonstrate Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail. A high level of computer literacy, including experience of word processing, spreadsheets and supporting the production of reports. The ability to use Microsoft 365 applications and specialised systems confidently and accurately. Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workload and work to deadlines. A flexible, proactive and enthusiastic approach to supporting service delivery. A commitment to providing a high-quality administrative service to the teams and clinicians we support. For informal enquiries relating to this post, please contact Sheila Galvin at sheila.galvin@nhs.scot or on 07385 978872. To work in the United Kingdom, there is a legal requirement for an individual to demonstrate that they have the relevant permission to work in the country. This permission is, without exception, granted by the UK Visa and Immigrations Service. As part of the pre-employment checks for a preferred candidate, NHS Scotland Boards will check your entitlement to work in the UK. It can be evidenced through a number of routes including specific types of visa as well as EU settled and pre-settled status. To find out more about these routes of permission, please refer to the GOV.UK website here. Please note that SAS is NOT licensed to issue certificates of sponsorship under current UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) regulations. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship to work with us. NHS Scotland is committed to encouraging equality and diversity among our workforce and eliminating unlawful discrimination. The aim is for our workforce to be truly representative and for each employee to feel respected and able to give their best. To this end, NHS Scotland welcomes applications from all sections of society.

Doesn't become flustered when priorities change or something unexpected happens. Has strong attention to detail, particularly when making changes to systems or handling financial information. Likes investigating a problem and finding the answer rather than simply passing it to somebody else. Can work independently once trained while knowing when something needs to be escalated. Enjoys being part of a busy, collaborative team. You don't need experience with Snappy's systems, we'll teach you those. What we're looking for is evidence that you've already worked in an environment where you've had to juggle customers, systems, processes and changing priorities. review_candidates.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. We are looking for a Senior HPC and AI Network Software Architect to help build the next generation of scalable AI infrastructure. The role emphasizes distributed training, real-time inference, and communication efficiency across large systems. You will develop new software and hardware approaches, shape platform evolution through hands-on innovation, and contribute to designing systems powering the fastest AI workloads globally. Collaborate with our distinguished team of researchers and engineers building software and hardware for AI at an outstanding scale. What You Will Be Doing Build and evolve the architecture of scalable software systems for distributed AI training and inference, focusing on throughput, latency, resiliency, and memory efficiency across cluster-scale deployments. Develop and evaluate next-generation communication and runtime capabilities in libraries such as NCCL, UCX, and UCC, tailored to the evolving demands of frontier AI workloads. Partner with AI framework teams (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX) and internal platform teams to build integrations, explore new approaches, and improve end-to-end performance and reliability. Collaborate on hardware and system-level features across GPUs, DPUs, and interconnects to speed up data movement and enable new capabilities for training, inference, and model serving at scale. Drive innovation across runtime systems, communication libraries, and AI-specific protocol layers, helping turn new ideas into practical capabilities and robust implementations. What We Need To See Ph.D., or equivalent industry experience, in computer science, computer engineering, or a closely related field. 5+ years of experience in systems programming, parallel or distributed computing, high-performance networking, or large-scale data movement, including experience designing and building complex systems. Strong programming background in C++, Python, and ideally CUDA or other GPU programming models, with a track record of building production-quality performance-critical software. Extensive hands-on experience with AI frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) and a solid grasp of how communication libraries and runtime systems facilitate large-scale training and inference. Demonstrated success in developing and refining high-throughput, low-latency systems, including the ability to reason across software stacks, hardware capabilities, and system bottlenecks. Strong collaboration skills in a multi-national, interdisciplinary setting, with the ability to contribute ideas, build momentum, and work effectively with senior engineers, researchers, and partner teams. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Deep expertise with NCCL, UCX, UCC, or similar communication libraries used in large-scale AI and HPC workloads. Strong background in networking and communication protocols, RDMA, collective communications, congestion-aware transport, or accelerator-aware networking. Comprehensive knowledge of large model training and inference serving at scale, including communication bottlenecks, scheduling challenges, and system-level tradeoffs across compute, memory, and fabric. Experience crafting hardware-software co-design for distributed AI systems, including contributions that advanced GPU, DPU, interconnect, or runtime capabilities. Familiarity with infrastructure for deployment of LLMs or transformer-based models, including sharding, pipelining, expert parallelism, or hybrid parallelism. At NVIDIA, you’ll work alongside individuals who are dedicated to continuous learning and creative problem-solving in the industry, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in AI and high-performance computing. If you're passionate about architecting distributed systems, advancing AI infrastructure, and solving problems at scale, we want to hear from you! Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. review_candidates.title: Chercheur post-doctoral en Neuro-Immunologie - H/F
review_candidates.description: L’Inserm est le seul organisme public français entièrement dédié à la recherche biologique, médicale et en santé des populations. Il dispose de laboratoires de recherche sur l’ensemble du territoire, regroupés en 12 Délégations Régionales. Notre institut réunit 15 000 chercheurs, ingénieurs, techniciens et personnels administratifs, avec un objectif commun : améliorer la santé de tous par le progrès des connaissances sur le vivant et sur les maladies, l’innovation dans les traitements et la recherche en santé publique. Rejoindre l’Inserm, c’est intégrer un institut engagé pour la parité et l’égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l’accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l’Inserm mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle. L'Inserm a reçu en 2016 le label européen HR Excellence in Research et s'est engagé à faire évoluer ses pratiques de recrutement et d'évaluation des chercheurs. Le Poste INSERM : UMR 1141 - NEURODIDEROT, Paris 19e Le poste est à pourvoir au sein de l'UMR 1141 - NEURODIDEROT (Inserm et Université Paris Cité), située à l'Hôpital Robert Debré à Paris (19e arrondissement). Cette unité est centrée sur la compréhension des mécanismes qui altèrent le fonctionnement du cerveau en développement. Vous intégrerez l’équipe 3IBrain, créée en 2025, qui opère à l’interface neurosciences-immunologie chez l’humain et dans les modèles précliniques. Description Du Poste Et Missions Le chercheur recruté sera l’exécutant scientifique principal du projet ANR JCJC SPLENIC-NET. Ce projet vise à démontrer que des neurones sympathiques organe-spécifiques issus des ganglions cœliaques régulent la capacité de présentation croisée des macrophages CD169⁺ et des cellules dendritiques cDC1, contrôlant ainsi l’immunité T CD8⁺ contre les antigènes circulants et tumoraux. Sous la responsabilité du coordinateur, il conduira de façon autonome les trois work packages du projet et contribuera à l’encadrement de l’étudiant en thèse associé. Ses Activités Principales Incluront La cartographie anatomique de l’innervation sympathique splénique (chirurgie stéréotaxique, injections de vecteurs AAV, clarification tissulaire CUBIC et imagerie light-sheet). L'isolement de neurones et de populations myéloïdes par cytométrie en flux, ainsi que l'analyse transcriptomique single-cell RNA-seq / AbSeq. La manipulation fonctionnelle des circuits neuronaux (sympathectomie chimique, ablation neuronale sélective, délétion conditionnelle). La gestion de modèles in vivo (infection à Listeria monocytogenes, leucémie C1498) et les tests ex vivo de présentation croisée. La dissection mécanistique par bulk RNA-seq et la réalisation d'analyses bio-informatiques (Seurat, DESeq2) sur cluster de calcul. La validation translationnelle sur rate humaine via cytométrie spectrale et tests pharmacologiques. La valorisation scientifique (rédaction d’articles, congrès, partage de code et données selon les principes FAIR). Profil Recherché Formation : Bac +8, Doctorat (PhD) en sciences de la vie et de la santé (immunologie, biologie cellulaire, neurosciences ou discipline connexe). Expérience : Le poste s’adresse à un chercheur confirmé justifiant d'une expérience post-doctorale solide. Une expérience combinée en immunologie et explorations de circuits neuro-immuns constitue un atout déterminant. Compétences indispensables : Immunologie cellulaire (présentation par le CMH-I, lymphocytes T CD8+), analyse de données de séquençage à haut débit, statistiques appliquées et parfaite maîtrise de la rédaction scientifique en anglais. Savoir-faire attendus : Biologie cellulaire primaire humaine et murine, cytométrie en flux multiparamétrique, imagerie 3D (confocale et light-sheet) et expérimentation animale. La maîtrise de la chirurgie stéréotaxique n'est pas exigée à l'entrée, un accompagnement sera assuré par l'équipe. Savoir-être : Autonomie, rigueur expérimentale, sens de l'organisation, esprit d'initiative et goût pour le travail collaboratif et interdisciplinaire. Conditions De Travail Type de contrat : CDD contractuel de 36 mois, temps plein (38h30 hebdomadaires). Prise de poste : 1er octobre 2026 (ou dès que possible). Rémunération : À partir de 2 997,20 € brut mensuel, en fonction de l'expérience professionnelle. Avantages : 32 jours de Congés Annuels et 12 RTT acquis dès le premier mois, télétravail partiel possible (1 à 2 jours pour les analyses bio-informatiques et la rédaction). Environnement technique : Accès aux plateformes de pointe (SFR Necker, Institut Imagine, NeuroDiderot). Modalités De Candidature Merci d'envoyer votre CV et une lettre de motivation, en précisant vos prétentions salariales, au Dr François-Xavier Mauvais.

review_candidates.description: Na GSK, somos movidos por ambições audaciosas para transformar vidas e gerar um impacto positivo na saúde de bilhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Ao unir inovação, colaboração e uma visão global, nossas funções globais tornam possível o desenvolvimento de nossas vacinas, medicamentos e inovações científicas, apoiando cada etapa do processo até que as soluções cheguem aos pacientes. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de contribuir diretamente para um futuro mais saudável e sustentável, trabalhando em um ambiente onde propósito e impacto caminham juntos. Na GSK, buscamos transformar o tratamento de doenças respiratórias, criando soluções que ajudam os pacientes a viver com mais liberdade. Essa posição faz parte de uma iniciativa global de MSLs dedicados ao pipeline da área respiratória, com atuação próxima aos centros de pesquisa clínica e investigadores em todo o Brasil, garantindo uma interface estratégica entre Medical Affairs e pesquisa clínica. Você será expert em pesquisa clínica de campo, atuando com alto grau de autonomia na interface entre centros de pesquisa, investigadores e a área médica da GSK, apoiando a execução dos estudos do pipeline respiratório e contribuindo para o avanço científico. Estabelecer uma interface consistente entre Medical Affairs e pesquisa clínica, garantindo alinhamento científico e operacional, com presença efetiva no campo. Priorizar e cobrir de forma autônoma os centros de maior relevância e necessidade no Brasil, organizando agenda, viagens e atividades de campo com maturidade e visão estratégica. Fornecer atualizações regulares sobre insights científicos e operacionais aos times internos, contribuindo para decisões estratégicas relacionadas ao pipeline respiratório, sempre em conformidade com os padrões de ética e compliance da GSK. Por que VOCÊ? Suas qualificações: Estamos à procura de pessoas com essas características para alcançar nossos objetivos: Ensino superior completo em área da saúde ou áreas correlatas e mestrado concluído na área da saúde. Experiência prévia como MSL ou experiência de campo em pesquisa clínica, atuando diretamente com centros e investigadores. Conhecimento consistente de estudos e pesquisa clínica, com capacidade comprovada de dialogar com investigadores e centros, interpretando e comunicando dados científicos de forma clara. Inglês avançado/fluente. Disponibilidade para atuação nacional com aproximadamente 80% do tempo em viagens/campo, e CNH B válida. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. review_candidates.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
review_candidates.description: Position Description At CGI, we’re building a Forward Deployed Engineering practice to turn complex customer challenges into working technology and measurable outcomes faster. As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work directly with customers to uncover the problems that matter, shape the right response and remain hands-on as ideas move from concept to production. Spanning software, AI, data, cloud and platforms, you’ll have ownership of meaningful engineering challenges and the freedom to experiment intelligently, balancing innovation with security, governance and human judgement. Embedded within collaborative delivery pods, you’ll work alongside specialists who share expertise and support your growth, while helping CGI establish reusable approaches and a new engineering capability that strengthens how we deliver technology-led transformation. CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go. Due to the secure nature of the programme, you will need to hold UK Security Clearance or be eligible to go through this clearance. This is a hybrid position. Your future duties and responsibilities In this role, you will work at the intersection of customer discovery and hands-on engineering. You’ll engage directly with users, sponsors and delivery teams to understand operational challenges, turn ambiguity into clear engineering hypotheses and prioritise opportunities according to business value. You’ll then take ownership of shaping, building, testing and improving solutions, staying close to the technology and its real-world impact rather than operating solely as an advisor. As part of a multidisciplinary customer-facing pod, you’ll combine engineering, architecture, DevSecOps and product thinking to move rapidly from problem discovery to measurable outcomes. You’ll explore how AI can improve services and productivity while applying sound judgement around security, data, governance and human oversight. Supported by specialists across CGI, you’ll share what you learn, coach colleagues and help establish reusable approaches that strengthen our emerging Forward Deployed Engineering practice. Discover & Define: Work with customers to uncover operational problems, desired outcomes, constraints and risks before selecting technology solutions. Build & Deliver: Design, develop, test and improve digital services, prototypes, integrations and accelerators across software, AI, data, cloud and platform technologies. Experiment & Innovate: Rapidly test engineering hypotheses and turn promising concepts into practical solutions with measurable value. Apply & Govern AI: Identify appropriate AI opportunities while addressing model limitations, data quality, security, governance and human oversight. Shape & Prioritise: Translate ambiguous requirements into use cases and delivery backlogs focused on customer outcomes rather than technology novelty. Engage & Influence: Lead workshops, demonstrations, playbacks and decision forums, communicating technical trade-offs clearly to customer and CGI stakeholders. Collaborate & Lead: Work within multidisciplinary delivery pods and take ownership of work packages or smaller delivery threads. Assure & Protect: Apply pragmatic engineering, security and assurance practices to create resilient, responsible and traceable solutions. Coach & Share: Pair with colleagues, provide constructive reviews and feedback, and turn delivery learning into reusable patterns. Build & Evolve: Help establish CGI’s Forward Deployed Engineering capability by contributing ideas, methods and engineering practices that can scale across customers. Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role You’ll bring strong hands-on engineering credibility combined with the communication and judgement needed to work directly with customers in complex, ambiguous environments. We’re interested in adjacent experience and learning agility rather than expecting every candidate to arrive with a traditional Forward Deployed Engineer background. You’ll be supported in developing across disciplines while bringing the curiosity, ownership and technical capability to turn customer problems into working solutions. Strong hands-on engineering experience, with evidence of designing and shipping modern digital solutions in complex environments. Technical breadth across software engineering, AI, data, cloud, platforms, solution architecture or DevSecOps, combined with deeper expertise in one or more areas. Experience working directly with customers or users to understand problems and translate them into practical technology solutions. Strong problem discovery and structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to operate effectively with ambiguity. Experience applying AI or AI-enabled technologies, with an understanding of their opportunities, limitations and responsible use. Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions and trade-offs clearly. Product and outcome-oriented thinking, with a focus on adoption, measurable value and solving the right customer problem. Good understanding of secure engineering, governance and assurance within modern technology delivery. Proven ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams, bringing together engineering, architecture, product and delivery perspectives. Strong learning agility and technical curiosity, with the ability to develop expertise quickly as customer challenges evolve. Ability to coach and support colleagues, share knowledge and contribute reusable approaches to an emerging practice. Commercial awareness, with an understanding of how engineering decisions influence customer value, delivery outcomes and value for money. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because… You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction. Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons. That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals. Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Develop country and account plans for priority markets, including target customers, programs, acquisition pathways, partner strategy, competitive positioning, and revenue milestones. Build a qualified pipeline and prioritize internal resources, executive engagement, travel, and partner investment toward the highest-value opportunities. Convert demonstrations, pilots, and evaluations into funded programs, fielded deployments, and follow-on business. Lead cross-functional teams across product, engineering, program management, capture, contracts, finance, legal, and export compliance. Develop and manage strategic channel partners, systems integrators, distributors, representatives, and industrial partners to improve market access and in-country execution. Demonstrated success delivering revenue growth in complex government, defense, aerospace, public-safety, border-security, or national-security markets. Proven experience selling complex hardware, aviation platforms, integrated systems, autonomous capabilities, UAS, ISR solutions, or comparable mission systems with long sales cycles and multi-stakeholder buying processes. Ability to independently build pipeline, shape requirements, lead capture and account strategy, negotiate complex agreements, and close high-value public-sector opportunities. Extensive experience with LATAM government, defense, security, public-safety, aviation, or acquisition stakeholders, including knowledge of regional procurement processes, budget cycles, tenders, local partnership models, and long sales cycles. Experience working with prime contractors, systems integrators, distributors, channel partners, and local industrial partners to support capture and delivery. Strong knowledge of aviation and UAS concepts of operation, platform capabilities, customer missions, and competitive dynamics, particularly for Group 2–5 UAS, ISR, border security, maritime security, and expeditionary applications. Strong executive communication, negotiation, forecasting, cross-functional leadership, and strategic account-planning skills. Professional fluency in Spanish and English, with the ability to meet applicable export-control, travel, background-screening, customer-access, anti-corruption, and third-party compliance requirements. Preferred Qualifications: Professional fluency in Portuguese. Experience selling Group 3–5 UAS, tactical ISR aircraft, aviation platforms, autonomy-enabled systems, AI-enabled software, command-and-control capabilities, or other advanced defense and security technologies in Latin America. Ability to translate aircraft performance, payload options, autonomy features, and technical specifications into mission value and customer outcomes. new_matches.title: Chercheur post-doctoral en Neuro-Immunologie - H/F
new_matches.description: L’Inserm est le seul organisme public français entièrement dédié à la recherche biologique, médicale et en santé des populations. Il dispose de laboratoires de recherche sur l’ensemble du territoire, regroupés en 12 Délégations Régionales. Notre institut réunit 15 000 chercheurs, ingénieurs, techniciens et personnels administratifs, avec un objectif commun : améliorer la santé de tous par le progrès des connaissances sur le vivant et sur les maladies, l’innovation dans les traitements et la recherche en santé publique. Rejoindre l’Inserm, c’est intégrer un institut engagé pour la parité et l’égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l’accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l’Inserm mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle. L'Inserm a reçu en 2016 le label européen HR Excellence in Research et s'est engagé à faire évoluer ses pratiques de recrutement et d'évaluation des chercheurs. Le Poste INSERM : UMR 1141 - NEURODIDEROT, Paris 19e Le poste est à pourvoir au sein de l'UMR 1141 - NEURODIDEROT (Inserm et Université Paris Cité), située à l'Hôpital Robert Debré à Paris (19e arrondissement). Cette unité est centrée sur la compréhension des mécanismes qui altèrent le fonctionnement du cerveau en développement. Vous intégrerez l’équipe 3IBrain, créée en 2025, qui opère à l’interface neurosciences-immunologie chez l’humain et dans les modèles précliniques. Description Du Poste Et Missions Le chercheur recruté sera l’exécutant scientifique principal du projet ANR JCJC SPLENIC-NET. Ce projet vise à démontrer que des neurones sympathiques organe-spécifiques issus des ganglions cœliaques régulent la capacité de présentation croisée des macrophages CD169⁺ et des cellules dendritiques cDC1, contrôlant ainsi l’immunité T CD8⁺ contre les antigènes circulants et tumoraux. Sous la responsabilité du coordinateur, il conduira de façon autonome les trois work packages du projet et contribuera à l’encadrement de l’étudiant en thèse associé. Ses Activités Principales Incluront La cartographie anatomique de l’innervation sympathique splénique (chirurgie stéréotaxique, injections de vecteurs AAV, clarification tissulaire CUBIC et imagerie light-sheet). L'isolement de neurones et de populations myéloïdes par cytométrie en flux, ainsi que l'analyse transcriptomique single-cell RNA-seq / AbSeq. La manipulation fonctionnelle des circuits neuronaux (sympathectomie chimique, ablation neuronale sélective, délétion conditionnelle). La gestion de modèles in vivo (infection à Listeria monocytogenes, leucémie C1498) et les tests ex vivo de présentation croisée. La dissection mécanistique par bulk RNA-seq et la réalisation d'analyses bio-informatiques (Seurat, DESeq2) sur cluster de calcul. La validation translationnelle sur rate humaine via cytométrie spectrale et tests pharmacologiques. La valorisation scientifique (rédaction d’articles, congrès, partage de code et données selon les principes FAIR). Profil Recherché Formation : Bac +8, Doctorat (PhD) en sciences de la vie et de la santé (immunologie, biologie cellulaire, neurosciences ou discipline connexe). Expérience : Le poste s’adresse à un chercheur confirmé justifiant d'une expérience post-doctorale solide. Une expérience combinée en immunologie et explorations de circuits neuro-immuns constitue un atout déterminant. Compétences indispensables : Immunologie cellulaire (présentation par le CMH-I, lymphocytes T CD8+), analyse de données de séquençage à haut débit, statistiques appliquées et parfaite maîtrise de la rédaction scientifique en anglais. Savoir-faire attendus : Biologie cellulaire primaire humaine et murine, cytométrie en flux multiparamétrique, imagerie 3D (confocale et light-sheet) et expérimentation animale. La maîtrise de la chirurgie stéréotaxique n'est pas exigée à l'entrée, un accompagnement sera assuré par l'équipe. Savoir-être : Autonomie, rigueur expérimentale, sens de l'organisation, esprit d'initiative et goût pour le travail collaboratif et interdisciplinaire. Conditions De Travail Type de contrat : CDD contractuel de 36 mois, temps plein (38h30 hebdomadaires). Prise de poste : 1er octobre 2026 (ou dès que possible). Rémunération : À partir de 2 997,20 € brut mensuel, en fonction de l'expérience professionnelle. Avantages : 32 jours de Congés Annuels et 12 RTT acquis dès le premier mois, télétravail partiel possible (1 à 2 jours pour les analyses bio-informatiques et la rédaction). Environnement technique : Accès aux plateformes de pointe (SFR Necker, Institut Imagine, NeuroDiderot). Modalités De Candidature Merci d'envoyer votre CV et une lettre de motivation, en précisant vos prétentions salariales, au Dr François-Xavier Mauvais.

Technical breadth across software engineering, AI, data, cloud, platforms, solution architecture or DevSecOps, combined with deeper expertise in one or more areas. Experience working directly with customers or users to understand problems and translate them into practical technology solutions. Strong problem discovery and structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to operate effectively with ambiguity. Experience applying AI or AI-enabled technologies, with an understanding of their opportunities, limitations and responsible use. Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions and trade-offs clearly. Product and outcome-oriented thinking, with a focus on adoption, measurable value and solving the right customer problem. Good understanding of secure engineering, governance and assurance within modern technology delivery. Proven ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams, bringing together engineering, architecture, product and delivery perspectives. Strong learning agility and technical curiosity, with the ability to develop expertise quickly as customer challenges evolve. Ability to coach and support colleagues, share knowledge and contribute reusable approaches to an emerging practice. Commercial awareness, with an understanding of how engineering decisions influence customer value, delivery outcomes and value for money.
